### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

The torchvision package consists of popular datasets, model architectures, and common image transformations for computer vision. Please refer to the [official instructions](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/) to install the stable versions of `torch` and `torchvision` on your system. To build source, refer to our [contributing page](https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development-installation). The following is the corresponding `torchvision` versions and supported Python versions. Torchvision currently supports the following image backends: - torch tensors - PIL images: - [Pillow](https://python-pillow.org/) - [Pillow-SIMD](https://github.com/uploadcare/pillow-
